image_description: A close-up, front-facing shot of a golden hamster gripping the edge of a white paper or cardboard structure. The hamster has dense golden-brown fur, prominent black eyes, rounded ears, and visible pink paws with claws. The background features a dark surface with red and yellow graphic elements, possibly packaging.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Broad head with prominent cheek pouches extending to shoulders.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is visibly broad and round. The fur density creates the characteristic fullness associated with cheek pouches, blending smoothly into the shoulder area.
Both eyes are clearly visible, small relative to the head, and dark/black in coloration with distinct specular highlights.
Ears are visible on both sides of the head, appearing rounded and proportionally large for a rodent of this size.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Stocky compact body with diminutive, rounded proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible torso behind the arms appears compact and rounded, consistent with the stocky build of a hamster.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dense short fur in golden, brown, black, or white coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur texture appears dense and short, with a consistent golden-brown hue typical of Syrian hamsters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short legs with clawed digits; hind feet slightly elongated.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front paws are clearly visible gripping the white edge. Individual digits and small claws are discernible. Hind feet are occluded but front limb anatomy is correct.
The rear of the animal is occluded by the foreground object and the angle of the shot; the tail is not visible.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The white object the hamster is holding has slightly smeared or melted edges where it meets the background and the paws. The text/graphics on the red section below appear distorted and illegible, suggesting minor generation artifacts in non-subject areas.
The grip of the right paw on the white edge is slightly ambiguous; the fingers seem to merge slightly with the white surface rather than having crisp separation, though it is largely plausible.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species (Syrian/Golden Hamster) and rule out misclassification as other rodents like gerbils or mice.
To verify the anatomical correctness of the front limbs and digit count, ensuring no extra or missing toes.
To check for edge bleeding between the fur and the background, and to ensure the paws are topologically distinct from the object they are holding.
To analyze the distorted text/graphics on the red/yellow background for gibberish or OCR failures, which are common AI artifacts.
To assess overall sharpness, noise levels, and any subtle lighting inconsistencies.

focus_areas: Digit integrity and separation from held object
Fur texture consistency and edge sharpness against background
Legibility and structural logic of background text/graphics
Symmetry and placement of facial features
